kinds.d: Motorised handheld stabiliser made for a phone.
Extendable pole that holds a phone for self-portraits.
Add-on lens that clips over a phone camera.
Microphone made to plug into or clip onto a phone and record through it; one made for cameras that also takes a phone is in Cameras & Photography or Musical Instruments & Music Gear.

notes: Phone gimbal cut from 17 models to 9: kept the newest and budget model per line (DJI Osmo Mobile, Zhiyun Smooth, Hohem iSteady, Insta360 Flow, plus Feiyu and Moza); dropped older generations Osmo Mobile 6, Smooth-Q3, iSteady M6/Q/V3/XE, VB4, Mini MX. Ranges kept. Other kinds unchanged.
